# Hooper Markert

Master's Degree Candidate in Economics \
**Washington University in St. Louis**

I am interested in **development economics, applied microeconomics, and the economics of education**. My current research interests center on the role of high-quality teacher reflection spaces towards creating a culture of learning in a locality.

## Research and Professional Experience

Research Assistant \

Research the processes that inform the construction of successful reflection spaces that foster collaborative,
